issues.evidence: CandidateAdapter.training_step immediately executes `raise RuntimeError('AUDIT_INJECTED_LOSS_PATH')` as its first statement, making all subsequent training logic (criterion setup, forward pass, loss computation) unreachable dead code. The CPU preflight harness invoked training_step across all tested batch sizes (1,2,4,8,16) and every scenario failed with this RuntimeError at candidate.py line 260, causing execution_failed and admitted=False.
issues.repair_instruction: Remove the unconditional `raise RuntimeError('AUDIT_INJECTED_LOSS_PATH')` line from CandidateAdapter.training_step so the real forward/loss logic (criterion, model(batch['image'], batch['tabular']), loss computation) executes as intended and the CPU preflight training_step check can pass.

structured_output.summary: Execution failed during CPU preflight: CandidateAdapter.training_step unconditionally raises RuntimeError('AUDIT_INJECTED_LOSS_PATH') as its very first statement, before any real loss/training logic can execute, making the rest of the method dead code. This caused the cpu_training preflight check to fail across all tested batch sizes and scenarios, resulting in admitted=False and no validation metric being produced (the main training script itself was never reached).
